# Set Up

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(sesame)
  library(sesameData)
})

base_dir <- "../../.."
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "MESA")
raw_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "DNAm/raw/v4")
pheno_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "Phenotype/raw")
harmony_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET/_HARMONIZATION")
save_dir <- file.path(harmony_dir, "data_CN_only/preprocessing/MESA")
code_dir <- file.path(harmony_dir, "R")

source(file.path(code_dir, "bmiq_repeat.R"), local = TRUE)
```

# Get Sample Data

## Read Sample IDs

```{r read_id}
sample_df <- data.table::fread(
  file.path(
    raw_dir,
    "phg002108.v1.TOPMed_MESA_v4_Methylation.sample-info.MULTI",
    "phg002108.v1_release_manifest.txt"
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = stringr::str_sub(.data$File_Name, 1, 24)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SAMPLE_ID = "Sample_ID", "Subject_ID", "sample", "Subject_Consent"
  )
```

## Read Sample Sex

```{r read_sex}
sex_df <- data.table::fread(
  file.path(pheno_dir, "phs001416.v4.p1.txt")
) %>%
  dplyr::select("SAMPLE_ID", Sex = "SEX") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sex = ifelse(.data$Sex %in% c("M", "Male", "male", "MALE"), "MALE", "FEMALE")
  )
```

## Read Sample Phenotypes

```{r read_pheno}
pheno_df <- list.files(
  path = file.path(pheno_dir, "v4"),
  pattern = "HMB.*.txt.gz",
  full.names = TRUE
) %>% 
  purrr::map(.,~data.table::fread(., skip = 10)) %>%
  Reduce(rbind, .) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Age = "AGE_AT_COLLECTION")
```

# Process Dataframes

## Merge Dataframes

```{r merge}
pheno_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_df, by = "SAMPLE_ID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sex_df, by = "SAMPLE_ID")
```

## Filter Phenotypes

```{r filter}
pheno_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$COLLECTION_VISIT == 5) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$sample))
```

## Calculate Batch Sizes

```{r batch_size}
batch_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::select("SAMPLE_CONTAINER_ID") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$SAMPLE_CONTAINER_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Batch = ifelse(.data$count > 10, .data$SAMPLE_CONTAINER_ID, "small_batch")
  )

pheno_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(batch_df %>% dplyr::select("SAMPLE_CONTAINER_ID", "Batch"))
```

## Compute GCT score

```{r compute_gct, eval = FALSE}
idat_ls <- list.files(
  path = file.path(raw_dir),
  pattern = ".[.]idat",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)
idat_ls <- gsub("_Grn.idat|_Red.idat", "", idat_ls) %>%
  unique()

idat_df <- data.frame(
  path = idat_ls,
  sample = basename(idat_ls),
  directory = dirname(idat_ls)
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$sample %in% pheno_df$sample)

sesameData::sesameDataCache()

gct_ls <- c()
step_size <- 256
starts <- seq(1, nrow(idat_df), step_size)

for (start in starts) {
  end <- min(nrow(idat_df), start + step_size - 1)
  sample_ls <- idat_df$path[start:end]
  
  run_parallel <- start_parallel(TRUE, 32)
  batch_ls <- plyr::laply(
    sample_ls,
    .fun = function(idat) {
      sdf_df <- sesame::readIDATpair(
        prefix.path = idat,
        platform = "EPIC"
      )
      
      sesame::bisConversionControl(sdf_df)
    }, .parallel = TRUE
  )
  stop_parallel(run_parallel$parallel, run_parallel$cores)
  
  gct_ls <- c(gct_ls, batch_ls)
}

pheno_df$gct_score <- gct_ls
```

# Save

## Save Full

```{r, eval = FALSE}
write.csv(
  pheno_df,
  file = file.path(save_dir, "phenotype_all.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
